record.label: Full-688 dynamic multistate residual CV
record.summary: All four fixed folds cover the complete 688-row effective observer_fit population exactly once and remain finite. Out-of-fold autonomous final MSE is 3.2969476163272226e-8 versus host 9.115992600417403e-8: 63.83% below host and 5.01% better than the prior scalar-exposure model, but 5.54% above the preregistered 3.123872816e-8 gate and 3.297x above the 1e-8 stretch target. Observer_selection was never opened; the static cost upper bound is 2,127,898,096,573 FLOPs and no literal meter was run after the accuracy failure.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for this exact four-state H96 six-epoch full-population spelling because verified autonomous OOF MSE 3.2969476163272226e-8 missed both its <3.123872816e-8 primary gate and the governing <1e-8 target; broader autonomous-state successors remain open.
